user_input: How many HashiCorp products were purchased in 2025?
retrieved_contexts: Generated Cypher: MATCH (c:Client)-[o:OPPORTUNITY]->(p:Product) WHERE toLower(p.name) CONTAINS 'hashicorp' AND o.opportunity_stage = 'Closed Won' AND o.close_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.close_date < '2026-01-01' AND toLower(p.vendor) CONTAINS 'hashicorp' RETURN count(*) as hashicorp_products_purchased
response: In 2025, 8 HashiCorp products were purchased by clients.
reference: Number of HashiCorp products purchased in 2025 with client details and total value.
